title: Thinking-only terminal turn ends session as success with stale text as result (empty_output_stop detector blind)
wanted_capability: A session whose model emits a thinking-only turn (no text, no tool_use) must not terminate as a clean success carrying stale mid-work narration as its result. Either auto-continue once (nudge the model to act/produce the final answer), or surface the empty-output stop in the result envelope (subtype/flag) so orchestrators see the deliverable is missing.
missing_primitive: Correct empty-output detection at turn end. Today `empty_output_stop` (agent_loop.rs:1515-1517) tests `final_text`, but `final_text` is assigned only on text-producing turns (agent_loop.rs:1172) — it is the LAST NON-EMPTY text of the whole session, not the terminal turn's text. Any session that narrated at least once can silently end on a thinking-only/empty turn with empty_output_stop=false, no suspicious-turn-end warning, and `result` = stale narration. The predicate needs the terminal turn's own text (track last_turn_text separately), and the suspicion needs to reach the result envelope — currently it only fires a tracing warn + diagnostics event when suspicious (agent_loop.rs:1396-1400).
fallback_used: Orchestrator-side: treat hasResult/completed as untrusted; verify the deliverable exists in the final message and bro_resume the session to demand the report when missing (worked — resume task 7d826c32 produced it).
evidence: Live repro 2026-06-10: deepseek-v4-pro session 557fdac2-9ce5-410f-9406-486aa12071f8 task 27f6c86d — invariant-audit run ended at 38 turns subtype=success; terminal assistant event (events.jsonl line 77) contained ONLY a 9,499-char thinking block (likely output-token cap mid-thinking); result field = stale narration from an earlier turn; orchestrator received completed-with-result and the actual report was never produced (session had to be bro_resume'd).
crates/bro-harness/src/agent_loop.rs:1172 (final_text only updated on text turns)
crates/bro-harness/src/agent_loop.rs:1396-1402 (suspicion only logged, result envelope unconditionally success)

Secondary observability hole: persisted assistant events carry stop_reason=None/usage=None — the daemon-side envelope drops the fields needed to distinguish max_tokens cuts from natural stops (harness tracks last_model_stop internally but only emits it in suspicious turn_end diagnostics).
suggested_owner: bro-harness / harness-dispatch-economics thread (9dfe1da5) — peer's active area, coordinate before editing agent_loop.rs
resolution_note: Addressed by ffd3996f (beta/blackbox-v2): (1) loop nudges once on empty-output stop (agent_loop.rs:1223-1241, one-shot guard) before accepting termination; (2) empty_output_stop detector now tests the TERMINAL step's text via last_turn_text (agent_loop.rs:1567-1607) instead of session-stale final_text; (3) suspicious turn-end diagnostics now ride the terminal result event as suspicious_turn_end (emit.rs:225-259) so orchestrators see the deliverable may be missing. Verified by code inspection + 8 passing regression tests (empty_output_stop_is_nudged_once_then_recovers, empty_output_stop_nudges_only_once_then_breaks, turn_end_diagnostics suite incl. max_turns-not-laundered case). Live repro not re-forced; unit tests simulate the empty-output stop path. Residual facet split out to a follow-up gap: persisted assistant events still drop stop_reason/usage (emit.rs:137-147), so max_tokens cuts remain indistinguishable from natural stops in the persisted stream.
